title: Persist Slide Modifications Across Navigation
description: Specs changed: all slides remember their modifications (drag/resize, enlarge, selection). Modifications reset only when reset buttons are pressed, not on slide navigation. Remove slideEpoch reset effect from usePresentationInteraction; clearSelection clears only selection not enlarge; add tests.
summary: Fixed selection lost after reveal overview (Escape): empty background clicks that start while `.reveal.overview` is active no longer call clearSelection, so zooming into a slide from the grid keeps prior selection. Added revealDeckInOverview helper and tests. All 104 renderer tests pass.
